name: Voice R-7 hosted credential, spend, tenant and engine boundaries incl. hosted LiveKit (Phone) on app.papercusp.com (portal e2e, 2026-10-06 run 3)
command: P=~/.papercusp-workspaces/papercusp-workspace/.papercusp/apps/portal; S=./.papercusp/scratch; LOG=$S/r7-boundaries-run3.log; cd "$P" || exit 1; date -u +STARTED=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$LOG"; git rev-parse HEAD | sed 's/^/PORTAL_HEAD=/' >> "$LOG"; git status --porcelain -- e2e/portal-voice-hosted-boundaries.spec.ts playwright.config.ts apps/host/src/api.ts | sed 's/^/PORTAL_DIRTY=/' >> "$LOG"; PORTAL_VOICE_BOUNDARIES_E2E=1 PORTAL_VOICE_BOUNDARIES_EVIDENCE_OUT=$S/r7-boundaries-run3-receipt.json npx playwright test e2e/portal-voice-hosted-boundaries.spec.ts --reporter=list >> "$LOG" 2>&1; echo "RUN_EXIT=$?" >> "$LOG"; date -u +FINISHED=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ >> "$LOG"; tail -14 "$LOG"
summary: portal/e2e/portal-voice-hosted-boundaries.spec.ts ran against the live hosted portal (https://app.papercusp.com) through the canonical portal playwright.config.ts with three freshly admitted TEST tenants: 4 passed, 0 failed, exit 0. Unauthenticated: /api/voice/elevenlabs/token 401; /api/voice/engines 401; /api/papercup-chat/conversations/boundary-probe/voice-session 401, no token minted. Engines advertised exactly {"elevenlabs":false,"livekit":true}. Retired /api/device/voice/turn GET+POST 404. Browser-delivered bodies scanned for secret patterns (46 responses, 2268621 bytes, twice): 0 findings. Tenant A start burst: 6 x 404 no-agent-id (hosted ElevenLabs fails closed, unconfigured per D-007), then 429 portal_voice_start_rate_limited Retry-After 60. Tenant B after A's burst: 404 no-agent-id (not throttled). Hosted LiveKit (Phone, /api/phone): unauthenticated call 401 with no grant; tenant A's spent budget refuses a LiveKit start too (429 portal_voice_start_rate_limited); a chat id tenant B does not own 404 portal_chat_not_found; tenants B and C each got a grant (200/200) with distinct room, token and LiveKit identity, each JWT room claim matching its grant; tenant C could not list (absent), export (404) or end (404 phone_call_not_found) B's room; both rooms ended (200/200). Exact-value secret compare: not run (pattern-only). 3 TEST users cleaned up.

disclosures: Secret scan is pattern-only (elevenlabs-sk_, openai-or-anthropic-sk-): no hosted secret value was supplied to the run (secretEnvChecked=[]), so no exact-value comparison ran.

Hosted ElevenLabs has no agent id configured (hosted EL is out of release scope per D-007), so every ElevenLabs start fails closed with 404 no-agent-id before any token exists; there is no live ElevenLabs token to compare across tenants. Cross-tenant grant distinctness is measured live on the advertised hosted engine (LiveKit), and for ElevenLabs at the unit layer (portal/tests/a-shared-mint-is-not-a-shared-token.test.ts).
Scope note, not an R-7 gap: the hosted spoken round trip and browser microphone denial belong to R-2/R-3/R-4 and run in the guided real-microphone session (D-005, D-009).
The run used the portal working tree at 4754eba2a343b1616506c3ca4d813d4180aa9bef with uncommitted changes (sourceDirtyAtRun); sourceFiles records the exact bytes that ran.
